name: cycvar
description: Cycvar speed simulator (Python engine, local web UI)

scripts.setup: uv venv -q .venv && uv pip install -q -p .venv numpy scipy matplotlib openpyxl litemapy
scripts.viz: .venv/bin/python viz/prepare.py && echo "Open http://127.0.0.1:8766/viz/" && .venv/bin/python -c "import http.server as h; f = h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.end_headers; h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.end_headers = lambda s: (s.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache'), f(s)); h.test(h.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, h.ThreadingHTTPServer, port=8766, bind='127.0.0.1')"
